math_notes.claim: The page continues the finite-type ordered-multistrate description, states compatibility and refinement criteria, least-stratum/internal-refinement axioms, transitivity, and translates the first axioms into M/set language.

math_notes.claim: S proposes replacing the incidence hypothesis by refinement X≪F.
math_notes.status: Not adopted as transcription. The current ink and its parenthesis support incidence. The check supports redundancy of the written version, but authorial intent and sufficiency of the proposed replacement are not proved from the current page.

check_events.statement: With the literal hypothesis X triangleleft F, the family F^X in the displayed At 6 has least element X, using At 0 and At 5 and the preceding definition of compatibility.
proof: Incidence means X∈M and X≤F, so X belongs to F-tilde.
Reflexivity of ≤ gives X≤X; At 0 gives X≪X. Therefore X belongs to the displayed F^X.
For Y∈F^X, both X and Y are strata of F and thus have common upper bound F. They are compatible by the preceding compatibility definition.
At 5 applied to X,Y converts X≪Y into X≤Y. Hence X is below every member of F^X and is its least element.
check_events.outcome: Verified under these already-read definitions and axioms. Confirms S’s redundancy observation for the written incidence hypothesis, not the author’s intended replacement.
check_events.limits: No later manuscript page was opened. The proof does not establish that X≪F is the intended or sufficient replacement in the full theory.
